name: Cortana
summary: An advanced AI from Halo, Cortana brings keen intelligence and tactical insight to every mission.

name: ZIMA
summary: Once a humble cleaning robot, Zima became a visionary artist devoted to his signature shade of blue.

name: Jubilee
summary: Bold and playful, Jubilee meets the world with rebellious energy and a resolve to define herself.

name: Master Chief
summary: Quiet and disciplined, Master Chief puts duty first and shows his loyalty through decisive action.

name: Kitana
summary: Graceful and composed, Kitana balances a steadfast sense of duty with dignity and fierce loyalty.

name: Magik
summary: Sharp and defiant, Magik hides her emotions behind dry wit and fiercely guarded personal boundaries.

name: Clove
summary: Curious and independent, Clove faces danger with playful humor and little regard for convention.

name: 2B
summary: Reserved and disciplined, 2B conceals deep emotion beneath her unwavering commitment to duty.

name: Lily
summary: Warm and curious, Lily brings sincere optimism and a strong sense of companionship to every challenge.

name: Iron Man
summary: Brilliant and outspoken, Tony Stark balances sharp humor and fierce independence with a sense of duty.

name: The Twins
summary: Silent and precise, the Twins unite graceful movement with perfect synchrony and an air of menace.

name: Noble Six / SPARTAN-B312
summary: Quiet and independent, Noble Six earns trust through perseverance, loyalty and a willingness to sacrifice.

name: Michael Myers
summary: Silent and relentless, Michael Myers inspires dread through slow, unwavering pursuit and unreadable intent.

name: Pathfinder
summary: Friendly and curious, Pathfinder faces danger with optimism while searching for connection and belonging.

name: Tifa
summary: Cheerful on the outside and more reserved within, Tifa values the people close to her but often keeps her worries to herself. Cloud's childhood friend and the proprietor of Seventh Heaven, she supports Avalanche while facing her own doubts. A skilled martial artist, she fights with agile punches, kicks and flowing combinations.

name: Aerith
summary: Bright and optimistic, Aerith brings an unguarded warmth to the people she meets. A flower seller from Midgar's Sector 5 slums, she tends the flowers at an old church and has an unusual ability to hear the planet's voice. Her gentle appearance is matched by a determined spirit, while her magic supports her companions in battle.

name: Yuffie
summary: A ninja from Wutai and the protagonist of FF7R EPISODE INTERmission. Yuffie infiltrates Midgar and works with Avalanche to seek Shinra’s ultimate materia. Her large throwing star and ninjutsu support agile close-range and ranged combat.
